name: Ripple Liquid Gallery
description: Dark bento grid of image tiles rendered in WebGL, where hovering a tile sends a liquid ripple distortion from the cursor and reveals the title and category.
contents: Bento grid of image tiles with mixed spans
Per-tile title and category caption over a gradient
behavior: Each tile renders its image on a WebGL canvas with cover-fit math
Hover eases in a ripple distortion centered on the cursor and eases it out on leave
Caption fades in and shine line sweeps across the tile on hover
editableByProps: Tiles, images, titles, categories and per-tile grid spans through the size class
Ripple strength, speed, frequency and hover duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the number of grid columns or row height
needsCodeEdit.where: md:grid-cols-3 and md:auto-rows-[170px] classes on the grid div

fixed: Needs WebGL support, one renderer per tile
Ripple reacts to mouse hover only, touch devices see static images with captions at rest
